hooks.command: npm run lint --silent 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -20

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'push +--force|push +-f\b|reset +--hard|rm +-rf|db:migrate|migrate +(up|down|deploy)|DROP +TABLE|branch +-D' && { echo 'BLOCKED by guard hook: destructive command requires explicit human approval. Ask the user, do not retry.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
